title: Minimum Moves To Equal Array Elements
statement:
Given an integer array nums of size n, return the minimum number of moves required to make all array elements equal. In one move, you can increment n - 1 elements of the array by 1.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3]
Output: 3
```

Explanation: Only three moves are needed (remember each move increments two elements): [1,2,3] => [2,3,3] => [3,4,3] => [4,4,4]

```text
Example 2
Input: nums = [1,1,1]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- n == nums.length
- 1 <= nums.length <= 10^5
- -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9
- The answer is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit integer.

One move increments n-1 array elements by 1. Return the minimum number of moves needed to make all elements equal.
